selection_notes: The default auto mode excludes only deprecated CWEs and requested abstraction mismatches from the full catalog.
Auto ranking uses direct rule precision, independent-file coverage, category evidence, CWE relationships, and repository platform matches in that order.
Large repositories reserve profile capacity for security-sensitive source paths before deterministic component/language sampling.
MITRE Top 25 membership is neither a ranking signal nor a reserved quota in auto mode.

For relationship-only and evidence-free candidates, the first pass admits at most two checks from one parent/ancestor family before backfilling; direct and category evidence is never suppressed by this diversity rule.
Platform mismatches affect rank rather than eligibility.
Repository-specific slots prefer direct source evidence, then category evidence, then MITRE relationship expansion; test and generated-code evidence is retained at lower weight.
Remaining tie-breakers are exact platform matches, CVE mapping guidance, abstraction, exploit likelihood, and status.

selected_checks.title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
reasons: Included from the authoritative MITRE CWE taxonomy
MITRE Software Development taxonomy member
Repository language or technology evidence matches MITRE platforms
Member of the current MITRE CWE Top 25
Member of MITRE's simplified vulnerability-mapping view
Member of the current MITRE OWASP Top Ten view
MITRE CVE mapping usage is Allowed (positive ranking signal)
Repository request-input evidence supports this CWE
Repository web-endpoint evidence supports this CWE
MITRE CWE relationship connects this entry to evidence-backed CWE-74
selected_checks.plain_language_summary: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.
selected_checks.why_it_matters: Potential consequences include Access Control, Confidentiality; Bypass Protection Mechanism, Read Application Data; Integrity, Confidentiality, Availability; Execute Unauthorized Code or Commands; Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability, Access Control; Exec. (Likelihood of Exploit: High)
